analysis: The tutorial demonstrates three actions: create an R2 bucket, make a bucket-scoped API token, then enter the bucket and credentials in MagicBolt AI. The uploaded reference is a long screen-recording tutorial; its sampled frames show those steps and the existing MagicBolt integration panel. Rebuild all screens as clean animated mock UI.

No voiceover transcript was supplied. The reference soundtrack could not be transcribed because the transcription utility writes temporary files under the studio directory, outside this workspace's write permission. Use sentence-based pacing after the narration is added.

The reference frames include real account content. The concepts use only the supplied demo bucket and mock credentials, with a placeholder endpoint. Official guidance: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/get-started/s3/ and https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/tokens/ .

concepts.name: Glass Console Walkthrough
concepts.idea: A bright, polished browser mockup guides viewers through the familiar Cloudflare and MagicBolt setup screens, one clear action at a time.
concepts.fonts: Poppins Bold for headings and Poppins Regular for interface labels; JetBrains Mono for credential fields.
concepts.motion: Soft glass panels rise into place; a cursor selects controls, bucket text types in, credentials copy across in a glossy chip, and a green connection toast lands. Fast, guided cuts with gentle background drift.

outline.what: Logo build and title: Cloudflare R2 Setup.
Open R2 and create the magic-assets bucket.
Choose bucket-only Object Read & Write and reveal mock credentials.
Type the demo bucket, key, secret, and placeholder endpoint; confirm success.
Play the existing logo animation in full.

concepts.name: Cloud-to-Bolt Bridge
concepts.idea: A cinematic deep-navy stage turns bucket creation and secure credential handoff into a glowing visual bridge between Cloudflare R2 and MagicBolt AI.
concepts.fonts: Poppins Bold for large step titles and Poppins Regular for supporting labels; JetBrains Mono for mock access values.
concepts.motion: Glossy cloud and bolt emblems anchor the mock panels. A dashed light path and floating credential chip travel between them; controls illuminate in sequence and resolve into a bright connected state.

outline.what: Logo build over a dark brand stage; introduce the R2-to-MagicBolt connection.
A Cloudflare R2 panel types magic-assets and confirms bucket creation.
Show bucket-only read/write scope and fly mock credentials across the bridge.
Complete the MagicBolt mock form and illuminate the successful connection.
Play the existing logo animation in full.
